meta_description:
themoneylancer on October 1, 2026: "Kya aap home loan ki EMI bhar rahe ho? Toh ye Reel poori zaroor dekhna, kyunki next few days aapke liye kaafi important ho sakte hain.

RBI ki 5–7 October ko meeting hone wali hai and expection is: is baar interest rates 25 basis points tak badh sakte hain.

Lekin question ye hai ki RBI ko suddenly rates badhane ki zarurat kyun pad rahi hai?

Iske peeche India ki economy ke saath-saath global situation bhi hai.

Middle East tensions ki wajah se crude oil $100 ke aas-paas pahunch gaya hai. India oil ka major importer hai, aur rupee bhi dollar ke against weak hua hai. Matlab oil import karna India ke liye aur costly ho gaya hai. Aur August ki 4.82% inflation, jo RBI ke 4% target se upar hai, isi pressure ko reflect karti hai.

Isi liye RBI ke saamne ab ek bada sawaal hai: inflation ko control karne ke liye rates badhaye jaayein ya nahi.

Isliye abhi apna loan check karo, aur agar financially possible ho toh part-prepayment consider karo kyunki principal kam hoga, toh future interest ka burden bhi kam ho sakta hai.

Lekin abhi panic mat karo kyoki rate hike abhi confirm nahi hui hai.

[ rbi rate hike, home loan emi, repo rate, interest rates india, inflation india, crude oil prices, loan prepayment, rbi monetary policy ]

#rbi #homeloan #interestrates #inflation #personalfinance".
